name: Chrome CDP
description: Drive an already-running Chrome/Chromium over the DevTools Protocol through a persistent daemon + unix socket (one macOS Local Network allow, then silent). Tool: ChromeCDP.

tool.name: ChromeCDP
tool.description: Control a running Chrome/Chromium over the full DevTools Protocol. Chrome must be launched with --remote-debugging-port=9222. A persistent background daemon holds one connection to the browser and is reached over a unix socket, so macOS prompts for Local Network access only once (at first use), not per command. Convenience actions cover tabs, JS eval, navigation, and downloads. The `send` action is a generic passthrough: it forwards any CDP method (Network.*, Performance.*, Tracing.*, Profiler.*, HeapProfiler.*, DOM.*, Page.*, Emulation.*, CSS.*, Accessibility.*, Storage.*, Fetch.*, Input.*, Log.*, Runtime.*, Target.*) with arbitrary params, optionally scoped to a tab. Because CDP events are async pushes (no reply), the daemon buffers them: enable a domain via `send` (e.g. Network.enable), then drain with `events`. Prefer the Fetch tool for stateless one-shot page reads; use ChromeCDP to act inside the user's real logged-in browser, inspect network/performance, profile, trace, or script anything the protocol exposes.

action.description: What to do. ping: daemon/browser liveness. targets: list open page tabs ({id,title,url}). alltargets: list every target incl. iframes/workers. eval: run JS in a tab. frameeval: run JS in a cross-origin child frame matched by URL substring. nav: navigate a tab. newtab: open a tab (returns its id). setdownload: set a tab's download dir. downloads: list tracked downloads. send: generic passthrough, call any CDP `method` with `params`, optionally scoped to `target`/`sessionId` (this is the full-protocol escape hatch: Network/Performance/Tracing/Profiler/DOM/Emulation/etc). events: drain buffered CDP events (filter/since/sessionId/limit/clear). record: toggle event recording on/off (auto-enabled when you `send` a *.enable). closetarget: close a tab. activatetarget: focus a tab. getinfo: TargetInfo for one tab.

target.description: Target (tab) id from `targets`/`newtab`. Required for eval, frameeval, nav, setdownload, closetarget, activatetarget, getinfo. Optional for `send` (scopes the call to that tab's session).

expr.description: JavaScript expression to evaluate (returned by value). Required for eval and frameeval. A thrown error comes back as {"__error":"..."}.

urlSub.description: Substring matched against child-frame URLs to pick the frame. Required for frameeval (e.g. "idmsa.apple.com" for an embedded Apple login).

url.description: Destination URL. Required for nav; optional for newtab (defaults to about:blank).

dir.description: Absolute directory for downloads. Required for setdownload.

method.description: CDP method in Domain.method form (e.g. "Network.enable", "Performance.getMetrics", "Page.captureScreenshot", "Tracing.start"). Required for `send`.

params.description: Params object for the `send` method (e.g. {"requestId":"..."} for Network.getResponseBody). Defaults to {} when omitted.

sessionId.description: Advanced: explicit CDP session id to scope a `send` call (overrides `target`). Usually you pass `target` instead.

filter.description: For `events`: case-insensitive substring matched against the CDP method name (e.g. "Network.responseReceived" or just "Network").

since.description: For `events`: return only events with seq strictly greater than this. Pass back the previous response's `cursor` to drain incrementally.

limit.description: For `events`: cap the number of returned events (most recent matching win).

clear.description: For `events`/`record`: drop the buffer after this call (events) or alongside the toggle (record).

on.description: For `record`: true to start buffering CDP events, false to stop. Defaults to true.
